links.outcome: Empirical coverage of conformal prediction uncertainty versus 90% target, and uncertain-flag rates by model
links.effect: Empirical coverage was close to the 90% target for every model; uncertain fraction ranged from 0.3% (Random Forest) to 59.9% (logistic regression) on the composite outcome.
links.quote: Conformal prediction achieved empirical coverage close to the 90% target for every model, yet the fraction of individuals flagged as uncertain differed widely between models with similar discrimination, ranging from 0.3% for Random Forest to 59.9% for logistic regression on the composite outcome.

unlisted_practices: Conformal prediction to flag unreliable individual predictions and direct confirmatory testing
Excluding outcome-defining biomarkers from predictors to prevent label leakage
Tiered deployment scenarios (community, primary-care, laboratory-supported) with nested predictor sets

screen.reason: Evaluates a deployment-oriented safeguard practice (conformal prediction to quantify uncertainty and identify patients for whom screening results are unreliable) across different clinical data tiers.
